tier_rules.potential: HIGH if canonical pred >= 6.0 or rank <= 10; MODERATE if pred >= 5.6; else LOW
tier_rules.stability: GOOD if median rank <= 15 and top10 freq >= 0.5; MODERATE if median rank <= 30 and top10 freq >= 0.25; else WEAK
tier_rules.tier_1: HIGH potential + GOOD stability + HIGH/MODERATE AD + physchem pass + supportive/moderate docking
